_note: Class levels and evolutions (Host introduces level-ups and the first evolution per class; later evolutions are Apex). XP is per class. Evolution unlock levels follow reference 02. An evolution is a new body form: stat deltas plus a full new silhouette. Each evolution also costs DNA and catalyst items (boss and nest organs), so the strongest bodies come from the hardest fights.

venomWraith.label: Acid Parasite
venomWraith.body: The Wraith's abdomen elongates into a translucent acid bladder you can see sloshing green; the wings shrink to stubs edged with acid-burn lace; the blades corrode into pitted hooks that smoke. Mixes: wasp, sea slug, pitcher plant.

venomWraith.label: Shadow-Stalker
venomWraith.body: The Wraith's chitin turns to a light-eating velvet, matte black-violet that swallows the glow of everything near it; the wings fold into a long cloak of membranes that drags without sound; the head narrows to a blade with no visible eyes, and two slits glow only in the half-second before it strikes. When it stands still in shadow it is a gap in the world. Mixes: velvet worm, owl feather, black-footed cat.

venomWraith.label: Xenoflyer
venomWraith.body: Four huge veined wings, each longer than the body, with smoky translucent panes that catch light like oil; true flight. The body stretches thin and long, the legs tuck into a landing cage, and the tail grows a dragonfly's segmented length ending in a hooked stinger. Hovering, it hums like a swarm. Mixes: dragonfly, manta ray, hornet.

neuroInfiltrator.label: Neuro-Hound
neuroInfiltrator.body: Drops to a four-legged lope: the bulbous cranium stretches forward into a long eyeless snout ringed with sensory antennae that sweep like a radar dish, the spine shows a ridge of glowing nerve nodes, and the gun arm becomes a forelimb with the Burster grafted along it. Mixes: star-nosed mole, greyhound, electric eel.

neuroInfiltrator.label: Spore-Caster
neuroInfiltrator.body: A walking fungal bloom: the Infiltrator's back splits into tiers of caps and gills that breathe visible spores; three chimney-like stalks rise from the shoulders and thump out spore mortars that arc and burst; the cranium is crowned with a frill of soft gills that flare when it fires. Moss and lichen creep over the rest. Mixes: shelf fungus, puffball, frilled lizard.

neuroInfiltrator.label: Psych-Warlock
neuroInfiltrator.body: It floats a hand's width off the ground. The skull has split along its seams into a halo of floating neural lobes, each tethered to the next by threads of light, slowly orbiting the bare stem of the brain. The body below thins to a trailing nervous system like a jellyfish. When it lashes a mind, the lobes all turn to face the target. Mixes: jellyfish, an exploded diagram, a saint's halo.

goreBehemoth.label: Crustacean Grunt
goreBehemoth.body: The raw red muscle is sealed under segmented crab-plate that clicks as it moves; one forearm swells into a heavy crushing claw that holds the Marrow Cannon, barnacle-like bone growths crust the shoulders, and eye stalks rise from the bone crown. Mixes: mantis shrimp, rhinoceros, coral.

goreBehemoth.label: Gore-Gorgon
goreBehemoth.body: The Behemoth's head and shoulders burst into a writhing crown of flesh-serpents, each a raw red muscle tube with its own small jaw of bone teeth, striking independently at anything in reach; the exposed muscle of the torso steams; the Marrow Cannon is gripped by two of the serpents instead of a hand. Mixes: hagfish, Medusa's silhouette (not her face), skinned bull.

goreBehemoth.label: Juggernaut-Titan
goreBehemoth.body: Twice the size: a walking fortress of fused bone plates grown in overlapping layers like tree rings, every step a dull crack. A furnace heart glows through a cage of ribs in the chest, venting heat shimmer; the arms are columns ending in bone mauls, one fused around the cannon. Moss and old arrows of other hosts' spines are stuck in its back. Mixes: elephant, termite mound, cathedral buttress.

armoury._note: Class signature weapons (weapons.json unlock): once the host reaches the level as that class, the Hive Armoury grows copies for DNA. A grown copy is an ordinary item: carried into a raid it can be lost.
